label: xerox c3-cmy7
tile_convention: tile [ty, tx] exactly as the parity record prints them: ty along the tall cell axis, tx along the wide one; page is 0 on every declared volume and is carried explicitly in target/control addresses as [page, ty, tx, stream].
cell_axes: cell y runs 0..cells_y, cell x runs 0..cells_x; cell_bbox and px_bbox are x-first half-open [x0, y0, x1, y1]; px x is the capture column (numpy axis 1) and px y the row (axis 0), so a crop is capture[py0:py1, px0:px1]; affine_cell_to_px maps px_x = a*cx + b*cy + c (row 0), px_y = d*cx + e*cy + f (row 1).
